title: Earn 100 Million
description: Start with pocket change and hunt market bargains—buy low, sell high across quirky commodities, invest in booming industries, and race to hit your first 100 million.
controls: Tap market listings to buy undervalued goods, advance days to watch prices swing, and invest profits into businesses.

zh-CN.title: 挣他一个亿
zh-CN.description: 现象级魔性经商模拟挣他一个亿：低买高卖倒腾爆款商品、抓准市场行情投资开公司，立个小目标先挣他一个亿！
zh-CN.controls: 低价买入热门货物、高价抛售赚取差价，投资实业资产冲击先挣一个亿的小目标。
